newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Dutch shares close at record after brush with 700.
newsitem.headline: Dutch shares close at record after brush with 700.

text.p: 1543 GMT - Dutch shares finish Tuesday at their third consecutive record high closing after briefly crossing the 700 level on the AEX for the first time. Strong fourth quarter results from Unilever provide the main push but strong dollar and bonds and early Tuesday Wall Street rise give support.
* AEX closes 3.68 points higher at record high 698.72. Opening gain on Wall Street sees AEX spike up to all time high 700.31, beating previous intra-day high of 698.21 set on Monday.
* Unilever closes 17.90 guilders, or 5.70 percent, higher at 331.30 after results and news of plans to sell chemical units.
*PolyGram up 3.70 to 83.30 ahead of 1996 results Wednesday.
